description: Perform a rate-limited live streamed GET for one direct-access dataset and compare transport receipts with the latest published evidence, e.g. verify_evidence('fuelprice'). Content dates, row counts, and shape fingerprints remain pipeline-only and are explicitly reported as unverified; results are ephemeral and never update health artifacts. Returns a dict with transport receipt fields and a `verdict` for downstream trust checks without re-fetching.

dataset_id.description: Canonical direct-access dataset identifier to re-fetch, e.g. 'fuelprice'.

verification.model: Signed probe attestation (Ed25519 L1, git-tag L2 anchor, per-dataset cosign keyless Sigstore bundle)
